card.name: Just before the letters 'orth' in worth
card.fires_on: The piece just before 'worth', 'worthy' or 'worn' is completed, such as 'self-w', 'unw', or 'be' before 'worth'. It also fires on a hyphen-w start, as in 'well-w'.

modes.label: Split worth-words
modes.description: A split start of worth or worthy, such as 'self-w' or 'unw', right before 'orth'.

modes.label: Before the word worth
modes.description: A word or comma right before a standalone 'worth' in a value or points phrase.
modes.example: First exam worth 120 pts, Final exam is comprehensive<<,>> worth 180 pts.

modes.label: Other w- starts
modes.description: A hyphen-w or w piece before a word like worn or wicked.

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with 'orth' spellings, such as worth or worthy, and away from the word worth itself.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to spell out 'worth' or 'worthy', as in 'unworthy' or 'self-worth'.
